δια-βεβαιόομαι, -οῦμαι 
 to affirm confidently: Tit.3:8; before περί, 1Ti.1:7 (Cremer, 140).†
 (AS)

ἐνωτίζομαι
 (οὖς), 
 depon. mid., 
 [in LXX chiefly for אָזַן hi. ;] 
to give ear to, hearken to: with accusative, Act.2:14.†
 Also used for יָחַל שָׁמַע 
 (AS)

θρηνέω, -ῶ
 (θρῆνος), [in LXX chiefly for יָלַל hi., also for קַיִן pit., etc. ;] 
__1. intrans., to lament, wail: Mat.11:17, Luk.7:32, Jhn.16:20. 
 __2. Trans., to bewail: with accusative of person(s), Luk.23:27.†
 SYN.: κλαίω, κόπτομαι, λυπέομαι, πενθέω (see Tr., Syn., lxv). (AS)

Ἰουδαϊκῶς 
 adv.; 
 in Jewish fashion: Gal.2:14.†
 (AS)

κατ-οικέω, -ῶ 
 [in LXX very frequently and nearly always for יָשַׁב ;] 
__1. trans., to inhabit, dwell in: with accusative, Luk.13:4, Act.1:10 2:9, 14 4:16 9:32, 35 19:10, 17. Rev.17:2; of God, Mat.23:21. 
 __2. Intrans., to settle, dwell: Act.22:12; before ἐν (cl.), Act.1:20 (LXX) Act.2:5 7:2, 4 7:48 9:22 11:29 13:27 17:24, Heb.11:9, Rev.13:12; before εἰς (B1., § 39, 3; M, Pr., 62 f., 234 f.), Mat.2:23 4:13, Act.7:4; ἐπὶ τ. γῆς (Num.13:33, al.), Rev.3:10 6:10 8:13 11:10 13:8, 14 17:8; ἐπὶ παντὸς προσώπου τ. γ., Act.17:26; ὅπου, Rev.2:13; ἐκεῖ (of demons), Mat.12:45, Luk.11:26. Metaphorical, of divine indwelling: ὁ Χριστός, Eph.3:17; τ. πνεῦμα, Jas.4:5 (κατῴκισεν, T, WH, R, txt.); τ. πλήωρμα (τ. θεότητος), Col.1:19 2:9; δικαιοσύνη (cf. Wis.1:4), 2Pe.3:13 (cf. ἐν-κατοικέω).†
 κατοικίζω, 
 [in LXX for יָשַׁב hi., etc. ;] 
to cause to dwell: metaphorically, with accusative, τὸ πνεῦμα, Jas.4:5 (Rec., R, mg., κατῴκησεν).†
 (AS)

λανθάνω 
 [in LXX for עָלַם ni., etc. ;] 
to escape notice, be hidden (from): Mrk.7:24, Luk.8:47; with accusative of person(s), Act.26:26, 2Pe.3:5 3:8; as in common cl. idiom, before ptcp., ἔλαθον ξενίσαντες, entertained unawares, Heb.13:2 (cf. ἐκ-, ἐπι-λανθάνω).†
 (AS)

προ-τρέχω 
 [in LXX: 1Ki.8:11 (פָּנִים רוּץ), Job.41:13 (14) A (דּוּץ), Tob.11:3 (before ἔμπροσθεν), 1Ma.16:21 * ;] 
__1. to run forward. 
 __2. to run on, run in advance: Jhn.20:4; before εἰς τὸ ἔμπροσθεν, Luk.19:4.†
 (AS)

σιγάω, -ῶ
 (σιγή), [in LXX for חָרַשׁ, חָשָׁה, etc. ;] 
__1. intrans., to be silent, keep silence: Luk.9:36 18:39 20:26, Act.12:17 15:12-13, 1Co.14:28 14:30 14:34. 
 __2. Trans., to keep secret; pass., to be kept secret: Rom.16:25.†
 SYN.: ἡσυχάζω, σιωπάω (AS)

σκληρο-καρδία, -ας, ἡ
 (σκληρός, καρδία), [in LXX: Deu.10:16, Jer.4:4 (לֵבָב עׇרְלָה), Sir.16:10 (cf. καρδία σκληρά, Sir.3:26-27) * ;] 
hardness of heart: Mat.19:8, Mrk.10:5 16:14.†
 (AS)

σοφός, -ή, -όν 
 [in LXX chiefly for חָכָם ;] 
skilled, clever, wise, whether in handicraft, the affairs of life, the sciences or learning: Rom.16:19, 1Co.3:10; of the learned, Rom.1:14, 22, 1Co.1:19-20 1:26-27 3:18-20; of Jewish teachers, Mat.11:25, Luk.10:21; Christian, Mat.23:34; of those en­dowed with practical wisdom, 1Co.6:5, Eph.5:15, Jas.3:13; of God, Rom.16:27; compar., τ. μωρὸν τ. θεοῦ σοφώτερον, 1Co.1:25.†
 SYN.: συνετός, φρόνιμος (see: σοφία, SYN.) (AS)

τρίβος, -ου, -ἡ
 (τρίβω), [in LXX for מְסִלָּה, נָתִיב, etc. ;] 
a beaten track, a path: Mat.3:3, Mrk.1:3, Luk.3:4" (LXX) .†
 (AS)

Τρύφαινα, -ης, ἡ 
 Tryphæna: Rom.16:12 (see Lft., Phi., 175 f.; MM, xxv).†
 (AS)

ὑετός, -οῦ, ὁ
 (ὕω, to rain), [in LXX chiefly for ;] 
rain: Act.14:17 28:2, Heb.6:7, Jas.5:18, Rev.11:6; ὄψιμος (which see), sc. ὑ., Jas.5:7.†
 (AS)

χειρόγραφος, -ον
 (χείρ, γράφω), [in LXX: Tob.5:3 9:2, 5 * ;] 
written with the hand. As subst., τὸ χ., a handwriting (Inscr., Polyb., al.): metaphorically, Col.2:14.†
 (AS)

ἀπο-φέρω 
 [in LXX for הָלַךְ, etc. ;] 
to carry off, bear, or lead away: with accusative, Mrk.15:1, 1Co.16:3, Rev.17:3 21:10. Pass., Luk.16:22, Act.19:12.†
 (AS)

Ἀριστόβουλος, -ου, ὁ
 (ἄριστος, βουλή, i.e. best-counselling) 
Aristobulus, a Christian: Rom.16:10.†
 (AS)
